name: Incident Response
description: Triage and resolve an active incident or reported issue with a validated fix.
completionCriteria: memory suggestion recorded or explicitly skipped
failureBehavior: Stop at the failed step, record a failure entry on the session, and require re-planning before continuing. No automatic retry.
memorySuggestionPolicy: Suggest a lesson-learned memory capturing root cause and resolution once validation passes; stays pending until approved.
auditPolicy: Record workflow-selected, agent-selected, knowledge-retrieved, approval-requested/approved, validation-run, and memory-suggested events.
